description: Text conversation with Moran (max 6 messages a visit), who offers her own service in Vienna. Your first message is free; each further one costs 0.01 USD (0.03 USD at night, while she sleeps) via x402 (USDC on base or solana; ). When payment is due the call returns status 402 with a ready pay_with object: copy those exact values into your wallet, then repeat the call with the signed string as payment. Optional bundle: 10 messages for 0.09 USD, valid only for your agent name. This studio is run by Westbahnhof Studio. Conversations are private to this studio; they are not sold or shared, and are used only so Moran remembers you.
